title: CXCL1 Supplementation on iPSC-Derived Midbrain Neurons
author: Elena Coccia

steps.title: Plate neurons (Day 25)
steps.instruction: On differentiation day 25, plate primary midbrain neurons at 100,000 cells per well in a 96‑well plate (100 µl per well) under standard culture conditions; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare CXCL1 stock and dilutions
steps.instruction: Reconstitute recombinant CXCL1 in 0.1 % BSA/PBS to a final concentration of 1 mg ml⁻¹; then dilute this stock in astrocyte‑conditioned media to working concentrations of 1 ng ml⁻¹, 10 ng ml⁻¹, 50 ng ml⁻¹, and 100 ng ml⁻¹.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute CXCL1 in 0.1 % BSA in PBS to 1 mg ml⁻¹.
Dilute the stock in astrocyte‑conditioned media to 1, 10, 50, and 100 ng ml⁻¹.

steps.title: First half-media change (Day 26)
steps.instruction: On day 26, perform the first half‑media change: remove 50 % of the existing media (50 µl) and add an equal volume (250 µl) of freshly prepared CXCL1‑supplemented conditioned media; for control wells add 0.1 % BSA in PBS instead of CXCL1.

substeps.instruction: Remove 50 % of the existing media (50 µl).
Add 250 µl of freshly prepared CXCL1‑supplemented conditioned media.
For control wells, add 0.1 % BSA in PBS as vehicle.

steps.title: Repeat half-media changes bi‑daily
steps.instruction: Continue half‑media changes every other day for four weeks, using the same CXCL1‑supplemented or control media as described.

steps.title: End of exposure: downstream analyses
steps.instruction: After the four‑week exposure period, proceed to downstream analyses.
